<script>
(() => {
  const SEL = {
    SECTION: '.sticky-tabs_section',
    WRAP: '.sticky-tabs_trigger',
    ACC_PARENT: '.accordion2_component[data-tab]',
    ACC_BODY: '.accordion2_bottom',
    IMG_ITEM: '.tab_image-container [data-tab]'
  };

  function debounce(fn, wait) {
    let t;
    return function (...args) {
      clearTimeout(t);
      t = setTimeout(() => fn.apply(this, args), wait);
    };
  }

  const norm = v => {
    const t = String(v ?? '').trim();
    const s = t.replace(/^0+(?=\d)/, '');
    return s === '' ? t : s;
  };

  // Batched read/write: measures every body with a single reflow for the whole set.
  function measureAllHeights(bodies) {
    const widths = bodies.map(el =>
      el.getBoundingClientRect().width || parseFloat(getComputedStyle(el).width) || 0
    );
    const prev = bodies.map(el => ({
      position: el.style.position,
      visibility: el.style.visibility,
      display: el.style.display,
      height: el.style.height,
      width: el.style.width
    }));
    bodies.forEach((el, i) => {
      el.style.position   = 'absolute';
      el.style.visibility = 'hidden';
      el.style.display    = 'block';
      if (widths[i]) el.style.width = widths[i] + 'px';
      el.style.height     = 'auto';
    });
    const heights = bodies.map(el => el.scrollHeight || 0);
    bodies.forEach((el, i) => {
      el.style.position   = prev[i].position;
      el.style.visibility = prev[i].visibility;
      el.style.display    = prev[i].display;
      el.style.height     = prev[i].height;
      el.style.width      = prev[i].width;
    });
    return heights;
  }

  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    if (!window.gsap || !window.ScrollTrigger) return;
    gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollTrigger);

    const mm = gsap.matchMedia();

    // Desktop only: nothing below 992px. matchMedia reverts on exit.
    mm.add('(min-width: 992px)', () => {
      const section = document.querySelector(SEL.SECTION);
      const wrap    = document.querySelector(SEL.WRAP);
      if (!section || !wrap) return;

      const comps    = Array.from(wrap.querySelectorAll(SEL.ACC_PARENT));
      const imgItems = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(SEL.IMG_ITEM));

      const left  = new Map();
      const right = new Map();

      comps.forEach(cmp => {
        const id  = norm(cmp.getAttribute('data-tab'));
        const body = cmp.querySelector(SEL.ACC_BODY);
        if (body) {
          body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
          if (getComputedStyle(body).display === 'none') body.style.display = 'block';
          left.set(id, { cmp, body });
        }
      });
      imgItems.forEach(node => {
        const id = norm(node.getAttribute('data-tab'));
        if (!right.has(id)) right.set(id, node);
      });

      const ids = [...left.keys()].filter(id => right.has(id)).sort((a,b)=>Number(a)-Number(b));
      if (!ids.length) return;

      let activeIndex = 0;
      const first = ids[0];

      comps.forEach(cmp => cmp.classList.remove('is-active'));
      left.get(first).cmp.classList.add('is-active');

      ids.forEach(id => {
        const body = left.get(id).body;
        body.style.height = (id === first ? 'auto' : '0px');
        gsap.set(right.get(id), { autoAlpha: id === first ? 1 : 0, pointerEvents: 'none' });
      });

      const heights = {};
      const bodies = ids.map(id => left.get(id).body);

      const measureAll = () => {
        const measured = measureAllHeights(bodies);
        ids.forEach((id, i) => { heights[id] = measured[i]; });
      };
      const lockActiveHeight = () => {
        const curId = ids[activeIndex];
        left.get(curId).body.style.height = heights[curId] + 'px';
      };
      const finalizeHeights = () => { measureAll(); lockActiveHeight(); ScrollTrigger.refresh(); };

      let loadHandler = null;
      if (document.readyState === 'complete') {
        finalizeHeights();
      } else {
        loadHandler = () => finalizeHeights();
        window.addEventListener('load', loadHandler, { once: true });
        if (document.fonts && document.fonts.ready) document.fonts.ready.then(finalizeHeights);
      }

      let busy = false;
      function goTo(index) {
        if (index === activeIndex || busy) return;
        if (!heights[ids[0]]) return;

        const curId = ids[activeIndex];
        const nxtId = ids[index];
        busy = true;

        comps.forEach(cmp => cmp.classList.remove('is-active'));
        left.get(nxtId).cmp.classList.add('is-active');

        gsap.timeline({
          defaults: { duration: 0.5, ease: 'power1.out' },
          onComplete: () => { activeIndex = index; busy = false; }
        })
        .to(left.get(curId).body, { height: 0 }, 0)
        .to(left.get(nxtId).body, { height: heights[nxtId] }, 0)
        .to(right.get(curId), { autoAlpha: 0 }, 0)
        .to(right.get(nxtId), { autoAlpha: 1 }, 0);
      }

      let isSyncing = false;
      let desiredIndex = null;
      let scrollEndTimer = null;
      let fallbackScrollHandler = null;

      function onScrollEnd(cb) {
        if (window.lenis && typeof window.lenis.on === 'function') {
          const once = () => {
            window.lenis.off('scrollend', once);
            cb();
          };
          window.lenis.on('scrollend', once);
          return;
        }
        fallbackScrollHandler = () => {
          clearTimeout(scrollEndTimer);
          scrollEndTimer = setTimeout(() => {
            window.removeEventListener('scroll', fallbackScrollHandler, { passive: true });
            cb();
          }, 140);
        };
        window.addEventListener('scroll', fallbackScrollHandler, { passive: true });
        fallbackScrollHandler();
      }

      const steps = ids.length - 1;
      ScrollTrigger.create({
        trigger: section,
        start: 'top top',
        end: 'bottom bottom',
        scrub: false,
        refreshPriority: 3,
        onUpdate: self => {
          if (isSyncing) return;
          const idx = Math.floor(self.progress * (steps + 0.000001));
          if (idx !== activeIndex) goTo(idx);
        }
      });

      function scrollTargetFor(index) {
        const clamped = Math.max(0, Math.min(index, steps));
        const rect = section.getBoundingClientRect();
        const sectionTop = rect.top + (window.pageYOffset || document.documentElement.scrollTop || 0);
        const scrollable = Math.max(0, section.offsetHeight - window.innerHeight);
        const progress = steps === 0 ? 0 : (clamped / steps);
        let y = sectionTop + progress * scrollable;
        y += (clamped > activeIndex) ? 1 : (clamped < activeIndex ? -1 : 0);
        return Math.max(0, y);
      }

      function scrollToIndex(index) {
        desiredIndex = Math.max(0, Math.min(index, steps));
        isSyncing = true;
        const targetY = scrollTargetFor(desiredIndex);
        if (window.lenis && typeof window.lenis.scrollTo === 'function') {
          window.lenis.scrollTo(targetY, { duration: 0.8 });
        } else {
          try { window.scrollTo({ top: targetY, behavior: 'smooth' }); }
          catch { window.scrollTo(0, targetY); }
        }
        onScrollEnd(() => {
          goTo(desiredIndex);
          desiredIndex = null;
          isSyncing = false;
        });
      }

      const clickHandlers = [];
      ids.forEach((id, idx) => {
        const { cmp } = left.get(id);
        cmp.style.cursor = 'pointer';
        const handler = (e) => {
          const link = e.target.closest('a[href]');
          if (link && link.getAttribute('href') && link.getAttribute('href') !== '#') return;
          scrollToIndex(idx);
        };
        cmp.addEventListener('click', handler);
        clickHandlers.push({ cmp, handler });
      });

      const resizeHandler = debounce(() => {
        measureAll();
        lockActiveHeight();
        ScrollTrigger.refresh();
      }, 120);
      window.addEventListener('resize', resizeHandler);

      // Cleanup when leaving desktop breakpoint.
      return () => {
        clickHandlers.forEach(({ cmp, handler }) => cmp.removeEventListener('click', handler));
        window.removeEventListener('resize', resizeHandler);
        if (loadHandler) window.removeEventListener('load', loadHandler);
        if (fallbackScrollHandler) window.removeEventListener('scroll', fallbackScrollHandler);
        // Clear inline heights so mobile shows its natural static layout.
        bodies.forEach(el => { el.style.height = ''; el.style.overflow = ''; });
      };
    });
  });
})();
</script>

<script>
(() => {
  function debounce(fn, wait) {
    let t;
    return function (...args) {
      clearTimeout(t);
      t = setTimeout(() => fn.apply(this, args), wait);
    };
  }

  function buildStats(trigger, items) {
    const deltaFromBottom = (el) => {
      const t = trigger.getBoundingClientRect();
      const c = el.getBoundingClientRect();
      return (t.bottom - c.bottom);
    };

    gsap.set(items, { opacity: 0 });
    items.forEach((item) => {
      const circle = item.querySelector(".stats_circle");
      const trail  = item.querySelector(".stats_trail");
      if (circle) gsap.set(circle, { y: () => deltaFromBottom(circle), opacity: 0 });
      if (trail)  gsap.set(trail, { scaleY: 0, opacity: 0, transformOrigin: "center bottom" });
    });

    const D = 0.9;
    const OVERLAP = D * 0.7;

    const tl = gsap.timeline({
      scrollTrigger: {
        trigger,
        start: "top top",
        end: "+=200%",
        scrub: 1,
        pin: true,
        anticipatePin: 1,
        invalidateOnRefresh: true,
        refreshPriority: 2
      },
      defaults: { ease: "power3.out" }
    });

    items.forEach((item, i) => {
      const circle = item.querySelector(".stats_circle");
      const trail  = item.querySelector(".stats_trail");
      const pos   = i === 0 ? 0 : `>-=${OVERLAP}`;
      const label = `go-${i}`;
      tl.add(label, pos)
        .to(item,  { opacity: 1, duration: 0.001 }, label)
        .to(trail, { opacity: 0.3, scaleY: 1, duration: D }, label)
        .to(circle,{ y: 0, opacity: 1, duration: D }, label);
    });

    const refreshHandler = debounce(() => ScrollTrigger.refresh(), 150);
    window.addEventListener("resize", refreshHandler);

    return () => window.removeEventListener("resize", refreshHandler);
  }

  function initStats() {
    if (!window.gsap || !window.ScrollTrigger) return;
    gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollTrigger);

    const trigger = document.querySelector(".sticky-trigger");
    const items = gsap.utils.toArray(".stats_wrapper");
    if (!trigger || !items.length) return;

    const mm = gsap.matchMedia();

    // Desktop only. matchMedia reverts the timeline/ScrollTrigger + cleanup below 992px.
    mm.add('(min-width: 992px)', () => {
      let cleanup = null;
      let built = false;

      const st = ScrollTrigger.create({
        trigger,
        start: "top 150%",
        once: true,
        onEnter: () => {
          if (!built) { built = true; cleanup = buildStats(trigger, items); }
        }
      });

      return () => {
        st.kill();
        if (cleanup) cleanup();
        // clear any inline styles GSAP set, so mobile shows the static layout
        gsap.set(items, { clearProps: "all" });
        items.forEach((item) => {
          const circle = item.querySelector(".stats_circle");
          const trail  = item.querySelector(".stats_trail");
          if (circle) gsap.set(circle, { clearProps: "all" });
          if (trail)  gsap.set(trail, { clearProps: "all" });
        });
      };
    });
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initStats);
  } else {
    initStats();
  }
})();
</script>

<script>
  gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollTrigger, SplitText);

  function initStickyTitleScroll() {
    const wraps = document.querySelectorAll('[data-sticky-title="wrap"]');

    wraps.forEach((wrap) => {
      // Build each wrap's animation only when it nears the viewport.
      ScrollTrigger.create({
        trigger: wrap,
        start: "top 150%",   // fire well before it's visible
        once: true,
        onEnter: () => buildStickyTitle(wrap)
      });
    });
  }

  function buildStickyTitle(wrap) {
    const headings = Array.from(wrap.querySelectorAll('[data-sticky-title="heading"]'));

    const masterTl = gsap.timeline({
      scrollTrigger: {
        trigger: wrap,
        start: "top 40%",
        end: "bottom bottom",
        scrub: true,
        refreshPriority: 1
      }
    });

    const revealDuration = 0.7;
    const fadeOutDuration = 0.7;
    const overlapOffset = 0.15;

    headings.forEach((heading, index) => {
      heading.setAttribute("aria-label", heading.textContent);
      const split = new SplitText(heading, {
        type: "words,chars",
        wordsClass: "word",
        charsClass: "char"
      });
      split.words.forEach((word) => word.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true"));
      gsap.set(heading, { visibility: "visible" });

      const headingTl = gsap.timeline();
      headingTl.from(split.chars, {
        autoAlpha: 0,
        stagger: { amount: revealDuration, from: "start" },
        duration: revealDuration
      });
      if (index < headings.length - 1) {
        headingTl.to(split.chars, {
          autoAlpha: 0,
          stagger: { amount: fadeOutDuration, from: "end" },
          duration: fadeOutDuration
        });
      }
      masterTl.add(headingTl, index === 0 ? 0 : `-=${overlapOffset}`);
    });
  }

  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", initStickyTitleScroll);
</script>

<style>
  /*Lenis*/
  html.lenis,
  html.lenis body {
    height: auto;
  }

  .lenis:not(.lenis-autoToggle).lenis-stopped {
    overflow: clip;
  }
  /* [data-banner="wrapper"]{
    overflow: hidden;
    max-height: 0;
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(-12px);
    pointer-events: none;

    transition:
      max-height 420ms ease,
      opacity 260ms ease,
      transform 420ms ease;
  }


  html.bannerAllowed [data-banner="wrapper"].isBannerVisible{
    max-height: 240px;
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0);
    pointer-events: auto;
  }


  html.bannerDismissed [data-banner="wrapper"]{
    max-height: 0 !important;
    opacity: 0 !important;
    transform: translateY(-12px) !important;
    pointer-events: none !important;
  } */

  [data-banner='wrapper'] {
    opacity: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  html.banner-will-show [data-banner='wrapper'] .banner__inner {
    transform: translateY(-100%);
  }

  html.bannerAllowed [data-banner='wrapper'].isBannerVisible {
    opacity: 1;
    pointer-events: auto;
    transition: opacity 260ms ease;
  }
  html.bannerAllowed [data-banner='wrapper'].isBannerVisible .banner__inner {
    transform: translateY(0);
    transition: transform 420ms ease;
  }

  /* Dismissed: collapse the reserved space so the page reclaims it (user-initiated, CLS-safe) */
  html.bannerDismissed [data-banner='wrapper'] {
    max-height: 0 !important;
    opacity: 0 !important;
    pointer-events: none !important;
    transition:
      max-height 300ms ease,
      opacity 200ms ease;
  }

  .lenis [data-lenis-prevent],
  .lenis [data-lenis-prevent-wheel],
  .lenis [data-lenis-prevent-touch] {
    overscroll-behavior: contain;
  }

  .lenis.lenis-autoToggle {
    transition-property: overflow;
    transition-duration: 1ms;
    transition-behavior: allow-discrete;
  }
  .swiper-wrapper[data-slider='infinite'] {
    will-change: transform;
  }
  /* Each content slide */
  .swiper {
    overflow: visible !important;
  }
  .swiper-slide {
    height: auto !important;
  }

  /* Sliders start hidden to avoid measuring mid-init */
  .slider-guard {
    visibility: hidden;
  }
  .slider-guard.is-ready {
    visibility: visible;
  }

  /* Default (JS off): show headings */
  [data-transition-typewriter] {
    visibility: visible;
  }
  [data-sticky-title='heading'] {
    visibility: visible;
  }

  /* JS on: hide until .isReady is added by your script */
  html.js [data-transition-typewriter] {
    visibility: hidden;
  }
  html.js [data-transition-typewriter].isReady {
    visibility: visible;
  }

  /* JS on: keep your existing sticky-title behavior (hidden) */
  html.js [data-sticky-title='heading'] {
    visibility: hidden;
  }

  /* Caret off until typing finishes */
  .typewriter-bar {
    opacity: 0;
  }
  .typewriter-bar.blink {
    opacity: 1;
  }
  @media (min-width: 992px) {
    .accordion2_component {
      opacity: 0.5;
      transition: opacity 1s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1);
    }
    .accordion2_component.is-active {
      opacity: 1;
      transition: opacity 1s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1);
    }
  }
  .bubble_container,
  .bubble_wrapper,
  .bubble_line-wrapper {
    will-change: transform;
  }

  .grid-canvas {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    z-index: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
  }
  .slick-list {
    overflow: visible !important;
  }
  .slick-list,
  .slick-slide {
    margin: 0 1rem;
    transition: transform 1s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1);
  }
  /* Smooth transform on slides themselves */
  .slider_card {
    transition:
      transform 180ms ease,
      filter 180ms ease;
  }
  .slider_card.scaled {
    transform: scale(0.93);
    filter: brightness(0.97);
  }
  .slide.slick-current {
    transition: transform 1s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1);
  }

  .slick-track {
    display: flex !important;
  }

  .slick-slide {
    height: inherit !important;
  }
  .clip .char {
    -webkit-background-clip: text;
    background-clip: text;
    color: transparent;
    -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent; /* required for Safari/iOS */
    display: inline-block; /* SplitText adds this, but keep it explicit */
  }

  .gradient_orange-pink .char {
    background-image: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--base-color-brand--orange), var(--base-color-brand--pink));
  }
  .gradient_pink-yellow .char {
    background-image: linear-gradient(45deg, var(--base-color-brand--pink), var(--base-color-brand--yellow));
  }
  .gradient_pink-purple .char {
    background-image: linear-gradient(315deg, var(--base-color-brand--purple), var(--base-color-brand--pink));
  }

  @media (max-width: 990px) {
    .slick-list,
    .slick-slide {
      margin: 0 0.5rem !important;
    }
  }
</style>

<script>
  (() => {
    try {
      const storageKey = 'bannerDismissed_session';
      const isDismissed = sessionStorage.getItem(storageKey) === 'true';
      document.documentElement.classList.add(isDismissed ? 'bannerDismissed' : 'bannerAllowed');
    } catch (e) {
      // If sessionStorage is blocked, allow banners
      document.documentElement.classList.add('bannerAllowed');
    }
  })();
</script>

    overflow: hidden;
    transition: max-height 0.3s ease;
  }

            /* --- Bottom banner positioning --- */
            [data-banner="wrapper"][data-banner-position="bottom"]{

            /* --- Bottom banner animation direction overrides --- */
            /* Hidden / closing state should move DOWN (not up) */
            [data-banner="wrapper"][data-banner-position="bottom"]{
              transform: translateY(12px);
            }

            /* Visible state sits at 0 */
            html.bannerAllowed
              [data-banner="wrapper"][data-banner-position="bottom"].isBannerVisible{

            }

            /* If dismissed, ensure it closes downward too */

              padding-left: 0rem !important;
            }

            .margin-left {
              margin-top: 0rem !important;
              margin-right: 0rem !important;
              margin-bottom: 0rem !important;
            }

            .padding-left {
              padding-top: 0rem !important;
              padding-right: 0rem !important;
              padding-bottom: 0rem !important;
            }

            .margin-horizontal {
              margin-top: 0rem !important;
              margin-bottom: 0rem !important;
            }

            .padding-horizontal {
              padding-top: 0rem !important;
              padding-bottom: 0rem !important;
            }

            .margin-vertical {
              margin-right: 0rem !important;
              margin-left: 0rem !important;
            }

            .padding-vertical {
              padding-right: 0rem !important;
              padding-left: 0rem !important;
            }

            [data-wf--rich-text-block--variant="medium"],
            [data-wf--rich-text-block--variant="medium"] p {
                font-size: var(--p-medium) !important;
            }

            [data-wf--rich-text-block--variant="regular"],
            [data-wf--rich-text-block--variant="regular"] p {
                font-size: var(--p-regular) !important;
            }
            /*ENSURE SECTION WITH STARS EFFECT IS ALWAYS RELATIVE*/

            [data-anim="stars"] {
                position: relative !important;
            }

            /* BUTTON GRADIENT EFFECT */

            .button-gradient {
              position: absolute;
              inset: -1px;
              border-radius: inherit;
              pointer-events: none;
              width: 220%;
              left: -60% !important;
              transform: translateX(-55%);
              transition: transform 2s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1);
              will-change: transform;
            }
            .button:hover .button-gradient,
            .button:focus-visible .button-gradient-blue{
              transform: translateX(55%);
            }
            /* GLASSMORPHISM BORDER EFFECT*/

            .glass_wrapper.logos, .work_slide, .stats_card::before {
              position: relative;
              background: hsl(from var(--base-color-brand--black) h s l / 0.1);
              backdrop-filter: blur(12px) !important;
            }

            .glass_wrapper.logos::before, .work_slide::before, .pricing_card-wrapper.team::before, [data-border="gradient"]::before {
              content: "";
              position: absolute;
              inset: 0;
              border-radius: inherit;
              border: 1px solid transparent;
              background: linear-gradient(354deg, var(--base-color-brand--black) 3%, #ffffff3d 51%, var(--base-color-brand--black) 97%, var(--base-color-brand--black) 103%) border-box;
              mask: linear-gradient(black, black) border-box,
                linear-gradient(black, black) padding-box;
              mask-composite: subtract;
            }

            [data-border="gradient-popup"]::before {
              content: "";
              position: absolute;
              inset: 0;
              border-radius: inherit;
              border: 3px solid transparent;
              background: linear-gradient(354deg, var(--base-color-brand--black) 3%, #ffffff3d 51%, var(--base-color-brand--black) 97%, var(--base-color-brand--black) 103%) border-box;
              mask: linear-gradient(black, black) border-box,
                linear-gradient(black, black) padding-box;
              mask-composite: subtract;
            }

            .stats_card::before, [data-border="pink"]::before,
            [data-border="orange"]::before,
                [data-border="orange-mag"]::before,
              [data-border="blue"]::before,
            [data-border="yellow"]::before,
    [data-border="yellow-purple"]::before,
                [data-border="mag-purple"]::before,
            [data-border="purple"]::before {
              content: "";
              position: absolute;
              inset: 0;
              border-radius: inherit;
              border: 2px solid transparent;
              background: linear-gradient(354deg, var(--base-color-brand--black) 3%, #ffffff3d 51%, var(--base-color-brand--black) 97%, var(--base-color-brand--black) 103%) border-box;
              mask: linear-gradient(black, black) border-box,
                linear-gradient(black, black) padding-box;
              mask-composite: subtract;
            }
              [data-border="orange-bottom"]::before, .case-study_card::before {
              content: "";
              position: absolute;
              inset: 0;
              border-radius: inherit;
              border: 1px solid transparent;
              background: linear-gradient(354deg, var(--base-color-brand--black) 3%, #ffffff3d 51%, var(--base-color-brand--black) 97%, var(--base-color-brand--black) 103%) border-box;
              mask: linear-gradient(black, black) border-box,
                linear-gradient(black, black) padding-box;
              mask-composite: subtract;
            }

            [data-border="pink"]::before {
              background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--base-color-brand--pink) 0%, var(--base-color-brand--orange) 100%) border-box;
              z-index: 1;
            }
            [data-border="orange"]::before {
              background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--base-color-brand--orange) 0%, var(--base-color-brand--yellow) 100%) border-box;
              z-index: 1;
            }
  [data-border="orange-mag"]::before {
    background: linear-gradient(
      90deg,
      var(--base-color-brand--orange) 0%,
      #C62A7D 100%
    ) border-box;
    z-index: 1;
  }
              [data-border="orange-bottom"]::before {
              background: linear-gradient(0deg, var(--base-color-brand--orange) 0%, var(--base-color-brand--yellow) 100%) border-box;
              z-index: 1;
            }
               [data-border="blue"]::before {
              background: linear-gradient(0deg, var(--base-color-brand--cyan) 0%, #007299 100%) border-box;
              z-index: 1;
            }
            [data-border="yellow"]::before {
              background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--base-color-brand--yellow) 0%, var(--base-color-brand--purple) 100%) border-box;
              z-index: 1;
            }
              [data-border="yellow-purple"]::before {
              background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--base-color-brand--purple) 0%, var(--base-color-brand--yellow) 100%) border-box;
              z-index: 1;
            }
            [data-border="purple"]::before {
              background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--base-color-brand--purple) 0%, var(--base-color-brand--pink) 100%) border-box;
              z-index: 1;
            }
  [data-border="mag-purple"]::before {
    background: linear-gradient(
      90deg,
      #C62A7D 0%,
      var(--base-color-brand--purple) 100%
    ) border-box;
    z-index: 1;
  }
            .stats_card[data-border="pink-purple"]::before {
              background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--base-color-brand--pink) 0%, var(--base-color-brand--purple) 100%) border-box;
              z-index: 1;
            }
            .stats_card[data-border="purple-yellow"]::before {
              background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--base-color-brand--purple) 0%, var(--base-color-brand--yellow) 100%) border-box;
              z-index: 1;
            }
            .glass_wrapper.logos::before {
              background: linear-gradient(354deg, var(--base-color-brand--black) 3%, #ffffff3d 51%, var(--base-color-brand--black) 97%, var(--base-color-brand--black) 103%) border-box;
              z-index: -1;
            }

            .work_slide::before, .pricing_card-wrapper.team::before, [data-border="gradient"]::before, [data-border="gradient-popup"]::before {
              background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--base-color-brand--yellow), var(--base-color-brand--pink) 27%, var(--base-color-brand--purple) 53%, var(--base-color-brand--orange) 79%, var(--base-color-brand--pink)) border-box;
              z-index: 1;
            }
            .case-list.w-dyn-items > .w-dyn-item:nth-child(1) .case-study_card::before {
              background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--base-color-brand--yellow) 0%, var(--base-color-brand--purple) 100%) border-box;
            }
            .case-list.w-dyn-items > .w-dyn-item:nth-child(2) .case-study_card::before {
              background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--base-color-brand--purple) 0%, var(--base-color-brand--orange) 100%) border-box;
            }
            .case-list.w-dyn-items > .w-dyn-item:nth-child(3) .case-study_card::before {
              background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--base-color-brand--orange) 0%, var(--base-color-brand--pink) 100%) border-box;
            }
            /* Vignette around background grid*/
            .overlay_wrapper::after {
              content: "";
              position: absolute;
              inset: 0; /* cover the whole grid */
              pointer-events: none; /* don’t block clicks */
              background: radial-gradient(
                circle,
                rgba(0,0,0,0) 70%,
                rgba(0,0,0,0.7) 100%
              );
            }

            /* MOBILE MENU HAMBURGER */

            .hamburger_wrap {
                --thickness: 0.2rem;
                --gap: 0.5rem;
                --rotate: 45;
              --width: 90%;
            }
            .w--open .hamburger_line:first-child {
                transform: translateY(calc(var(--thickness) * 0.5 + var(--gap) * 0.5)) rotate(calc(var(--rotate) * -1deg));
            }
            .w--open .hamburger_line:last-child {
                transform: translateY(calc(var(--thickness) * -0.5  + var(--gap) * -0.5)) rotate(calc(var(--rotate) * 1deg));
            }
            .w--open .hamburger_wrap:hover {
                --width: 90%;
            }

            /* PRODUCT CARDS COMPONENT */

            .product-image_border::before {
              content: "";
              position: absolute;
              z-index: -1;
              inset: 0;
              border: 3rem solid transparent;
            }
            strong {
            font-weight: 500 !important;
            }
            [content-image="yellow"] {
                background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--base-color-brand--yellow) 0%, var(--base-color-brand--orange) 100%) border-box;
            }
            [content-image="orange"] {
                background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--base-color-brand--orange) 0%, var(--base-color-brand--pink) 100%) border-box;
            }
            [content-image="pink"] {
                background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--base-color-brand--pink) 0%, var(--base-color-brand--purple) 100%) border-box;
            }
            [content-grid="left"] {
                flex-flow: row-reverse;
            }
            .flex-comp:has([image-visibility="hide"]) {
                display: flex;
                flex-direction: column !important;
                width: 100% !important;
            }
            [data-text-size="regular"] {
             font-size: var(--p-regular);
            }
            [data-text-size="large"] {
                font-size: var(--p-large);
            }

            [image-visibility="hide"] ~ .meet_content-wrapper {
                max-width: 80%;
                align-items: center;
            }
            [image-visibility="hide"] ~ .meet_content-wrapper p, [image-visibility="hide"] ~ .meet_content-wrapper .heading-card {
                text-align: center !important;
            }
            [image-visibility="hide"] {
                display: none;
            }


            /*[card-height="tall"] {
                min-height: 26.75rem;
            }*/

            [card-height="tall"] {
                min-height: auto;
            }

            [card-height="short"] {
                min-height: auto;
            }
            [card-content-layout="side"] {
              display: grid;
              flex-flow: column;
              justify-content: flex-start;
              align-items: flex-start;
              grid-auto-columns: 1fr;
              gap: 4rem;
              place-items: end;
              grid-template-columns: auto minmax(auto, 1fr);
              grid-template-rows: auto;
            }

            /* SLIDER ATTRIBUTES TRUE OR FALSE */

            [data-slider="true"] {
                display: block !important;
            }
            [data-slider="false"], .grid-auto {
            display: grid !important;
            gap: 1.5rem;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(360px, 1fr));
            max-width: 100%;
            }
            [data-slider-arrows="true"] {
              display: flex;
            }
            [data-slider-arrows="false"] {
              display: none;
            }

            @media (max-width: 991px) {
            [content-grid="left"] {
                flex-flow: column;
            }

            [card-height="short"], [card-height="tall"] {
                min-height: auto !important;
            }
            [card-content-layout="side"] {
              display: flex;
              flex-flow: column;
              align-content: flex-start;
            }
            [data-slider="false"], .grid-auto {
            display: grid !important;
            gap: 1.5rem;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            max-width: 100%;
            }
            }
            @media (min-width: 1024px) and (max-width: 1366px) {
                .circle_wrapper {
                    height: 100%;
                    max-height: 70%;
                }
                    .gradient_pink-purple.clarity {
                    height: 100%;
                    max-height: 70%;
                }
            }

   /* Viewport for both modes */
  [data-banner-mode],
  [data-banner-marquee="true"] {
    overflow: hidden;
    position: relative;
  }

  /* ============================================
     BANNER: marquee
     ============================================ */

  [data-banner-mode="marquee"] .bannerMarqueeTrack,
  [data-banner-marquee="true"] .bannerMarqueeTrack {
    display: flex;
    width: max-content;
    will-change: transform;
    animation-name: bannerMarqueeScroll;
    animation-timing-function: linear;
    animation-iteration-count: infinite;
    animation-duration: var(--bannerMarqueeDuration, 20s);
  }

  [data-banner-mode="marquee"] .bannerMarqueeItem,
  [data-banner-marquee="true"] .bannerMarqueeItem {
    flex: 0 0 auto;
    white-space: nowrap;
    /* Applied to EVERY item, including the last.
       The trailing gap is part of the measured loop distance. */
    margin-right: var(--bannerMarqueeGap, 24px);
  }

  /* Opt-in pause on hover: data-banner-pause-hover="true" */
  [data-banner-pause-hover="true"]:hover .bannerMarqueeTrack {
    animation-play-state: paused;
  }

  @keyframes bannerMarqueeScroll {
    from { transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0); }
    to   { transform: translate3d(calc(-1 * var(--bannerMarqueeDistance, 0px)), 0, 0); }
  }

  /* ============================================
     BANNER: slider
     ============================================ */

  [data-banner-mode="slider"] .bannerSliderTrack {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: nowrap;
    width: 100%;
    will-change: transform;
    transition-property: transform;
    transition-timing-function: cubic-bezier(0.65, 0, 0.35, 1);
    transition-duration: 0ms;
  }

  [data-banner-mode="slider"] .bannerSliderItem {
    flex: 0 0 100%;
    width: 100%;
    min-width: 100%;
    /* No margin here: slides are exactly 100% of the viewport */
  }

  /* ============================================
     BANNER: static
     ============================================ */

  [data-banner-active-mode="static"] [data-banner="content"]:not(:first-child) {
    display: none;
  }

  /* ============================================
     BANNER: reduced motion
     ============================================ */

  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .bannerMarqueeTrack { animation: none; }
    .bannerSliderTrack  { transition-duration: 0ms !important; }
  }

  /* ============================================
     Unrelated: pricing CTA gradient border
     (move this to your pricing styles)
     ============================================ */

  .pricing_cta-block::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    border-radius: inherit;
    padding: 1px;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, #FFA8BB 0%, #F55200 34.13%, #9600FF 66.83%, #FFF58C 100%);
    -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(#fff 0 0) content-box, linear-gradient(#fff 0 0);
    -webkit-mask-composite: xor;
    mask-composite: exclude;
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  display: flex !important;
  flex-direction: row !important;
  justify-content: center !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  bottom: auto !important;

    position: relative !important;

</style>

<script>
(function () {
  function initHomeSliders() {
    const isMobile = window.matchMedia("(max-width: 991px)").matches;

    document.querySelectorAll(".home-slider-wrapper").forEach(function (wrap) {
      const swiperEl = wrap.querySelector(".swiper");
      if (!swiperEl) return;
      const slides = swiperEl.querySelectorAll(".swiper-slide");
      const navWrap = wrap.querySelector(".slider-navigation-wrapper");
      if (slides.length <= 1) {
        if (navWrap) navWrap.style.display = "none";
        return;
      } else {
        if (navWrap) navWrap.style.display = "";
      }
      const slider = new Swiper(swiperEl, {
        slidesPerView: 'auto',
        centeredSlides: true,
        initialSlide: 0,
        spaceBetween: 95,
        speed: 600,
        allowTouchMove: true,
        grabCursor: true,
        navigation: {
          nextEl: wrap.querySelector(".swiper-next"),
          prevEl: wrap.querySelector(".swiper-prev")
        },
        pagination: {
          el: wrap.querySelector(".swiper-pagination"),
          type: 'bullets',
          clickable: true
        },
        breakpoints: {
          992: { spaceBetween: 95 },
          0: { spaceBetween: 40 }
        }
      });
      if (isMobile) {
        slider.updateAutoHeight(0);
        setTimeout(function () { slider.updateAutoHeight(0); }, 200);
      }
    });
  }

  function whenReady() {
    if (typeof Swiper !== "undefined") {
      initHomeSliders();
      return;
    }
    // Global Swiper 11 bundle hasn't loaded yet: poll until it's available
    let tries = 0;
    const timer = setInterval(function () {
      if (typeof Swiper !== "undefined") {
        clearInterval(timer);
        initHomeSliders();
      } else if (++tries > 100) { // ~5s safety cap
        clearInterval(timer);
        console.warn("Swiper never loaded. Check the global v11 script in the footer.");
      }
    }, 50);
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", whenReady);
  } else {
    whenReady();
  }
})();
</script></div><div class="code-embed w-embed"><style>

(function () {
  function initPlanet() {
    gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollTrigger);
    const container = document.querySelector('.planet-lottie');
    const video = container && container.querySelector('.planet-video');
    if (!video) return;

    const mm = gsap.matchMedia();

    // Always draw a stable first frame so mobile (and pre-scrub desktop) shows the planet.
    video.addEventListener('loadeddata', () => {
      try { video.currentTime = 0; } catch (e) {}
    }, { once: true });

    // Desktop only: wire up the scroll scrub. Reverts below 992px.
    mm.add('(min-width: 992px)', () => {
      let built = false;

      const build = () => {
        if (built) return;
        built = true;
        const dur = video.duration || 1;
        const playhead = { t: 0 };

        gsap.to(playhead, {
          t: dur,
          ease: 'none',
          scrollTrigger: {
            trigger: container,
            start: 'top bottom',
            end: 'bottom top',
            scrub: 2,
            invalidateOnRefresh: true,
          },
          onUpdate: () => {
            const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(dur, playhead.t));
            if (video.readyState >= 3) video.currentTime = t;
          },
        });

        ScrollTrigger.refresh();
      };

      let cpHandler = null;
      let safetyTimer = null;

      if (video.readyState >= 3) {
        build();
      } else {
        cpHandler = () => build();
        video.addEventListener('canplaythrough', cpHandler, { once: true });
        safetyTimer = setTimeout(() => {
          if (!built && video.readyState >= 1) build();
        }, 3000);
      }

      // Cleanup when leaving desktop: matchMedia kills the scrub ScrollTrigger,
      // and we reset the video to its static first frame.
      return () => {
        if (cpHandler) video.removeEventListener('canplaythrough', cpHandler);
        if (safetyTimer) clearTimeout(safetyTimer);
        try { video.currentTime = 0; } catch (e) {}
      };
    });
  }

  function whenReady() {
    if (typeof gsap !== 'undefined' && typeof ScrollTrigger !== 'undefined') {
      initPlanet();
      return;
    }
    let tries = 0;
    const timer = setInterval(function () {
      if (typeof gsap !== 'undefined' && typeof ScrollTrigger !== 'undefined') {
        clearInterval(timer);
        initPlanet();
      } else if (++tries > 100) {
        clearInterval(timer);
        console.warn('GSAP or ScrollTrigger never loaded. Check the global scripts in the footer.');
      }
    }, 50);
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', whenReady);
  } else {
    whenReady();
  }
})();
</script></div><div class="hide w-embed"><style>

    var wraps = document.querySelectorAll("[data-btn-swap]");

    function apply(y) {
      var s = y >= T ? "scrolled" : "top";
      wraps.forEach(function (w) { w.setAttribute("data-btn-swap", s); });
      ticking = false;
    }
    function onScroll(y) { if (!ticking) { ticking = true; requestAnimationFrame(function () { apply(y); }); } }
    if (window.lenis) {
      window.lenis.on("scroll", function (e) { onScroll(e.scroll || e.animatedScroll || 0); });
      apply(window.lenis.scroll || 0);
    } else {
      window.addEventListener("scroll", function () { onScroll(window.pageYOffset); }, { passive: true });
      apply(window.pageYOffset);
    }
  })();

(function () {
  const allowedHosts = new Set(["fathom.video", "www.fathom.video"]);
  const timestampWindowMs = 10 * 60 * 1000; // 10 minutes
  const navigationDelayMs = 150; // small delay to let flush/beacon send

  function shouldDecorate(linkUrl) {
    return linkUrl && allowedHosts.has(linkUrl.host);
  }

  function decorateUrl(linkUrl) {
    const amp = window.amplitude;
    if (!amp || typeof amp.getDeviceId !== "function" || typeof amp.getSessionId !== "function") return linkUrl;

    const deviceId = amp.getDeviceId();
    const sessionId = amp.getSessionId();

    if (deviceId) linkUrl.searchParams.set("ampDeviceId", deviceId);
    if (sessionId != null) linkUrl.searchParams.set("ampSessionId", String(sessionId));

    linkUrl.searchParams.set("ampTimestamp", String(Date.now() + timestampWindowMs));
    return linkUrl;
  }

  function isModifiedClick(e) {
    return e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey || e.shiftKey || e.altKey || e.button !== 0;
  }

  function isNewTab(a) {
    const t = (a.getAttribute("target") || "").toLowerCase();
    return t === "_blank";
  }

  function handleClick(e) {
    const a = e.target && e.target.closest ? e.target.closest("a[href]") : null;
    if (!a) return;

    if (isModifiedClick(e)) return; // don't break cmd/ctrl click, etc.

    let linkUrl;
    try { linkUrl = new URL(a.href, window.location.href); } catch (_) { return; }
    if (!shouldDecorate(linkUrl)) return;

    // Always decorate the href
    const decorated = decorateUrl(linkUrl).toString();
    a.href = decorated;

    // Don't block new-tab behavior
    if (isNewTab(a)) return;

    // Same-tab: try to flush before leaving
    const amp = window.amplitude;

    // If SDK isn't ready yet, we can't do much—let navigation proceed.
    if (!amp || typeof amp.flush !== "function") return;

    // Prevent default nav, flush, then navigate
    e.preventDefault();

    try {
      // Ensure beacon transport (if available)
      if (typeof amp.setTransport === "function") amp.setTransport("beacon");
    } catch (_) {}

    try { amp.flush(); } catch (_) {}

    setTimeout(function () {
      window.location.href = decorated;
    }, navigationDelayMs);
  }

  document.addEventListener("click", handleClick, true);

  // Backstop: try to flush when the page is being hidden/unloaded
  window.addEventListener("pagehide", function () {
    try { window.amplitude?.flush?.(); } catch (_) {}
  });
})();
</script>

<script>
  //REDIRECT KEEP PARAMS
  (function() {
  var referrer = document.referrer;
  var currentSearch = window.location.search;

  if (referrer && !currentSearch) {
    try {
      var referrerUrl = new URL(referrer);
      var referrerParams = referrerUrl.search;

      if (referrerParams) {
        var isSameDomain = referrerUrl.hostname === window.location.hostname;
        if (isSameDomain) {
          window.history.replaceState(null, '', window.location.pathname + referrerParams + window.location.hash);
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {}
  }
})();
</script>


<script>
(function () {
  let lenis = null;
  let rafId = null;

  function startLenis() {
    if (lenis) return;
    lenis = new Lenis();
    window.lenis = lenis; // other scripts check window.lenis; keep it set on desktop

    function raf(time) {
      lenis.raf(time);
      rafId = requestAnimationFrame(raf);
    }
    rafId = requestAnimationFrame(raf);
  }

  function stopLenis() {
    if (!lenis) return;
    cancelAnimationFrame(rafId);
    rafId = null;
    lenis.destroy();
    lenis = null;
    window.lenis = null;
  }
  
  function setup() {
    if (window.gsap && typeof gsap.matchMedia === 'function') {
      const mm = gsap.matchMedia();
      mm.add('(min-width: 992px)', () => {
        startLenis();
        return () => stopLenis();
      });
    } else {
      const mq = window.matchMedia('(min-width: 992px)');
      const apply = (e) => { e.matches ? startLenis() : stopLenis(); };
      apply(mq);
      mq.addEventListener('change', apply);
    }
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', setup);
  } else {
    setup();
  }
})();
</script>

<script>
(function ($) {
  function armSliderGuard($slider) {
    let armed = false;
    const ready = () => {
      if (armed) return;
      armed = true;
      $slider.addClass('is-ready');
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event('layout:stable'));
      // Nudge ScrollTrigger for good measure
      setTimeout(() => ScrollTrigger && ScrollTrigger.refresh && ScrollTrigger.refresh(), 50);
    };

    $slider
      .on('init', () => { /* initial pass */ })
      .on('setPosition reInit breakpoint', () => {
        // debounce a touch; slick can fire a few in a row
        clearTimeout($slider.data('_guard_t'));
        $slider.data('_guard_t', setTimeout(ready, 80));
      });
  }

  $(function () {
    $('.slider_center, [data-slider="true"]').each(function () {
      const $s = $(this);
      $s.addClass('slider-guard');
      armSliderGuard($s);
    });
  });
})(jQuery);
</script>

<script>
$('.slider_center').each(function () {
  const $slider = $(this);
  const desktop = parseInt($slider.data('slides-desktop')) || 3;
  const tablet  = parseInt($slider.data('slides-tablet'))  || 2;
  const mobile  = parseInt($slider.data('slides-mobile'))  || 1;

  $slider.slick({
    slidesToShow: desktop,
    centerMode: true,
    swipe: true,
      touchMove: true,
      vertical: false,
      draggable: true,
    swipeToSlide: true,
      arrows: true,
    prevArrow: $('.arrow_prev-c'),
      nextArrow: $('.arrow_next-c'),
      centerPadding: '10px',
    responsive: [
      {
        breakpoint: 990,
        settings: { slidesToShow: tablet }
      },
      {
        breakpoint: 660,
        settings: { slidesToShow: mobile }
      }
    ]
  });
});
  
    // Ensure ScrollTrigger updates once Slick is rendered
  $('.slider_center').on('setPosition', function () {
    ScrollTrigger.refresh();
  });

  $(window).on('load', function () {
    setTimeout(() => {
      ScrollTrigger.refresh();
    }, 100);
  });
</script>

    const tablet  = parseInt($el.attr('data-left-slides-tablet'),  10) || 2;

      ScrollTrigger.refresh();
    }, 100);
  });
</script>

<script>
(function () {
  // CONFIG
  const CELL_SIZE = 80;
  const PROB_OF_NEIGHBOR = 0.9;
  const AMT_FADE_PER_FRAME = 1;
  const BASE_INTENSITY = 0.6;
  const MAX_OPACITY = 120;

  const GRADIENT_STOPS = [
    { pos: 0.00, color: '#FFA8BB' },
    { pos: 0.33, color: '#F55200' },
    { pos: 0.66, color: '#9600FF' },
    { pos: 1.00, color: '#FFF58C' }
  ];

  const section = document.querySelector('.grid-section');
  if (!section) return;

  function startGrid() {
    // ---- canvas setup ----
    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    canvas.classList.add('grid-canvas');
    section.appendChild(canvas);
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

    let w, h, numRows, numCols, gradient, bgColor;
    let rafId = null;
    const dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);

    function sizeCanvas() {
      const b = section.getBoundingClientRect();
      w = Math.floor(b.width);
      h = Math.floor(b.height);
      canvas.width  = w * dpr;
      canvas.height = h * dpr;
      canvas.style.width  = w + 'px';
      canvas.style.height = h + 'px';
      ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
      numRows = Math.ceil(h / CELL_SIZE);
      numCols = Math.ceil(w / CELL_SIZE);
      buildGradient();
      readSectionBackground();
    }

    function buildGradient() {
      gradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, w, 0);
      GRADIENT_STOPS.forEach(s => gradient.addColorStop(s.pos, s.color));
    }

    function readSectionBackground() {
      const computed = getComputedStyle(section).backgroundColor;
      bgColor = (computed && computed !== 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)') ? computed : 'rgba(0,0,0,0)';
    }

    sizeCanvas();
    const ro = new ResizeObserver(() => sizeCanvas());
    ro.observe(section);

    // ---- in-view gating ----
    let inView = true;
    const io = new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
      inView = entries[0]?.isIntersecting ?? true;
    }, { threshold: 0 });
    io.observe(section);

    // ---- pointer tracking (mouse only; this runs on desktop) ----
    let pointerInSection = false;
    let hasInteracted = false;
    let lastLocalX = 0, lastLocalY = 0;

    function toLocalXY(evt) {
      const r = section.getBoundingClientRect();
      const x = evt.clientX;
      const y = evt.clientY;
      return {
        x: Math.max(0, Math.min(r.width,  x - r.left)),
        y: Math.max(0, Math.min(r.height, y - r.top))
      };
    }

    const onEnter = () => { pointerInSection = true; };
    const onLeave = () => { pointerInSection = false; };
    const onMove = (e) => {
      pointerInSection = true;
      const { x, y } = toLocalXY(e);
      lastLocalX = x; lastLocalY = y;
      hasInteracted = true;
    };
    section.addEventListener('mouseenter', onEnter);
    section.addEventListener('mouseleave', onLeave);
    section.addEventListener('mousemove', onMove);

    // ---- state ----
    let currentRow = -2, currentCol = -2;
    const neighbors = new Map();

    function keyFor(row, col) { return row + ':' + col; }

    function upsertCell(row, col, targetOpacity) {
      if (row < 0 || col < 0 || row >= numRows || col >= numCols) return;
      const key = keyFor(row, col);
      const existing = neighbors.get(key);
      if (existing) {
        existing.opacity = Math.min(MAX_OPACITY, Math.max(existing.opacity, targetOpacity));
      } else {
        neighbors.set(key, { row, col, opacity: Math.min(MAX_OPACITY, targetOpacity) });
      }
    }

    function addRandomNeighbors(row, col) {
      for (let dRow = -1; dRow <= 1; dRow++) {
        for (let dCol = -1; dCol <= 1; dCol++) {
          const nRow = row + dRow;
          const nCol = col + dCol;
          const isCurrent = dRow === 0 && dCol === 0;
          const inBounds = nRow >= 0 && nRow < numRows && nCol >= 0 && nCol < numCols;
          if (!isCurrent && inBounds && Math.random() < PROB_OF_NEIGHBOR) {
            upsertCell(nRow, nCol, MAX_OPACITY);
          }
        }
      }
    }

    ctx.lineWidth = 1;

    function frame() {
      rafId = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
      if (!inView) return;

      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
      if (bgColor !== 'rgba(0,0,0,0)') {
        ctx.fillStyle = bgColor;
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
      }

      if (!hasInteracted) return;

      if (pointerInSection) {
        const row = Math.floor(lastLocalY / CELL_SIZE);
        const col = Math.floor(lastLocalX / CELL_SIZE);
        if (row !== currentRow || col !== currentCol) {
          currentRow = row;
          currentCol = col;
          upsertCell(row, col, MAX_OPACITY);
          addRandomNeighbors(row, col);
        }
      }

      ctx.strokeStyle = gradient;

      const toDelete = [];
      for (const [key, n] of neighbors) {
        n.opacity = Math.max(0, n.opacity - AMT_FADE_PER_FRAME);
        if (n.opacity <= 0) { toDelete.push(key); continue; }
        ctx.globalAlpha = (n.opacity / 255) * BASE_INTENSITY;
        ctx.strokeRect(n.col * CELL_SIZE, n.row * CELL_SIZE, CELL_SIZE, CELL_SIZE);
      }
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

      toDelete.forEach(key => neighbors.delete(key));
    }

    rafId = requestAnimationFrame(frame);

    // Teardown for when we drop below 992px
    return () => {
      if (rafId) cancelAnimationFrame(rafId);
      ro.disconnect();
      io.disconnect();
      section.removeEventListener('mouseenter', onEnter);
      section.removeEventListener('mouseleave', onLeave);
      section.removeEventListener('mousemove', onMove);
      canvas.remove();
    };
  }

  function setup() {
    if (window.gsap && typeof gsap.matchMedia === 'function') {
      const mm = gsap.matchMedia();
      mm.add('(min-width: 992px)', () => {
        const teardown = startGrid();
        return teardown; // fully removes canvas + loop below 992px
      });
    } else {
      const mq = window.matchMedia('(min-width: 992px)');
      let teardown = null;
      const apply = (e) => {
        if (e.matches && !teardown) teardown = startGrid();
        else if (!e.matches && teardown) { teardown(); teardown = null; }
      };
      apply(mq);
      mq.addEventListener('change', apply);
    }
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', setup);
  } else {
    setup();
  }
})();
</script>

<script>
  // Astronaut bob — runs on ALL devices (kept outside any gating)
  gsap.to('.image_astronaut', {
    y: -14, duration: 3, ease: 'sine.inOut', yoyo: true, repeat: -1
  });

  const wrappers = gsap.utils.toArray('[data-anim="stars"]');
  const dpr = Math.min(2, window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
  const rnd = (min, max) => Math.random() * (max - min) + min;

  wrappers.forEach(initStarsInstance);

  function initStarsInstance(wrap) {
    const canvases = Array.from(wrap.querySelectorAll('.stars .layer'));
    if (!canvases.length) return;

    const starCache = new WeakMap();
    let booted = false;

    function initCanvasSize(canvas) {
      const cw = wrap.clientWidth;
      const ch = wrap.clientHeight;
      canvas.width  = Math.max(1, Math.floor(cw * dpr));
      canvas.height = Math.max(1, Math.floor(ch * dpr));
      canvas.style.width  = cw + 'px';
      canvas.style.height = ch + 'px';
    }

    function generateStarsOnce(canvas) {
      initCanvasSize(canvas);
      const count = +canvas.dataset.count || 100;
      const minR  = +canvas.dataset.minr  || 0.6;
      const maxR  = +canvas.dataset.maxr  || 1.8;
      const stars = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        stars.push({
          u: Math.random(),
          v: Math.random(),
          r: rnd(minR, maxR) * dpr,
          c: Math.random() < 0.8 ? 'rgba(250, 245, 245, 0.45)' : '#bfe8ff'
        });
      }
      starCache.set(canvas, { stars, minR, maxR });
    }

    function drawStars(canvas) {
      const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
      const w = canvas.width, h = canvas.height;
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
      const cached = starCache.get(canvas);
      if (!cached) return;
      const { stars, minR, maxR } = cached;

      ctx.save();
      ctx.shadowBlur = 8 * dpr;
      ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(190,230,255,0.35)';
      for (let i = 0; i < stars.length; i++) {
        const s = stars[i];
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(s.u * w, s.v * h, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c;
        ctx.fill();
      }
      ctx.restore();

      const twinkleCount = Math.max(4, Math.floor(stars.length * 0.05));
      for (let i = 0; i < twinkleCount; i++) {
        const x = Math.random() * w;
        const y = Math.random() * h;
        const r = rnd(minR * 0.8, maxR * 1.4) * dpr;
        const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, r * 2.2);
        grad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.6)');
        grad.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(160,220,255,0.35)');
        grad.addColorStop(1, 'transparent');
        ctx.fillStyle = grad;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(x, y, r * 2.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
      }
    }

    function drawAll() {
      canvases.forEach(cv => {
        if (!starCache.has(cv)) generateStarsOnce(cv);
        else initCanvasSize(cv);
        drawStars(cv);
      });
    }

    // Paint the stars once — ALL devices (this is the "static canvas").
    const boot = () => {
      if (booted) return;
      booted = true;
      requestAnimationFrame(drawAll);
    };
    if (document.readyState === 'complete') boot();
    else window.addEventListener('load', boot, { once: true });

    // Redraw on resize (keeps stars crisp) — cheap, keep on all devices.
    const ro = new ResizeObserver(() => {
      if (!booted) return;
      requestAnimationFrame(drawAll);
    });
    ro.observe(wrap);

    let resizeRaf;
    window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
      if (!booted) return;
      cancelAnimationFrame(resizeRaf);
      resizeRaf = requestAnimationFrame(drawAll);
    });

    // DESKTOP ONLY: the continuous drift + pointer parallax (the expensive loops).
    if (window.gsap && typeof gsap.matchMedia === 'function') {
      const mm = gsap.matchMedia();
      mm.add('(min-width: 992px)', () => {
        // Pointer parallax
        const onPointerMove = (e) => {
          const r = wrap.getBoundingClientRect();
          const mx = (e.clientX - r.left) / r.width - 0.5;
          const my = (e.clientY - r.top)  / r.height - 0.5;
          canvases.forEach((el, i) => {
            const depth = (i + 1) * 6;
            gsap.to(el, { x: mx * depth, y: my * depth, duration: 0.6, overwrite: true });
          });
        };
        wrap.addEventListener('pointermove', onPointerMove);

        // Idle drift (infinite loop) — the main mobile cost, now desktop-only
        const drift = gsap.to(canvases, {
          x: (i) => `+=${(i + 1) * 2}`,
          y: (i) => `+=${(i + 1) * 1}`,
          duration: 20,
          ease: 'none',
          repeat: -1,
          yoyo: true
        });

        // Cleanup below 992px: stop the loop, remove listener, reset transforms
        return () => {
          wrap.removeEventListener('pointermove', onPointerMove);
          drift.kill();
          gsap.set(canvases, { clearProps: 'transform' });
          requestAnimationFrame(drawAll); // repaint static after clearing transforms
        };
      });
    }
  }
</script>


<script>
// Make sure jQuery + Slick are loaded
$('.slider').each(function () {
  const $track = $(this);
  const $wrap  = $track.closest('.carousel_wrapper');

  // helpers scoped to this slider only
  const addScaled    = () => $wrap.find('.slider_card').addClass('scaled');
  const removeScaled = () => $wrap.find('.slider_card').removeClass('scaled');

  // bind before .slick() so "init" fires
  $track.on('init', function (e, slick) {
    const $list = $(slick.$list);

    // press/drag start -> add scale
    $list.on('mousedown.sscale touchstart.sscale', addScaled);

    // release anywhere -> remove scale
    $(document).on('mouseup.sscale touchend.sscale', removeScaled);

    // safety: leaving the viewport also removes
    $list.on('mouseleave.sscale', removeScaled);
  });

  // also clear scale after a swipe or slide change
  $track.on('swipe afterChange', removeScaled);

  // INIT slick (cleaned options)
  $track.slick({
variableWidth: true,
  swipeToSlide: true,
  touchMove: true,
  draggable: true,
  prevArrow: $('.arrow_prev'),
  nextArrow: $('.arrow_next'),
  infinite: false,
  speed: 150,  
  arrows: true,
  cssEase: 'linear'
  });
});
</script>
<script>
  gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollTrigger, ScrambleTextPlugin, SplitText);

  function initScrambleOnScroll() {
    const targets = document.querySelectorAll('[data-scramble="scroll"]');

    targets.forEach((target) => {
      const isAlternative = target.hasAttribute("data-scramble-alt");

      const split = new SplitText(target, {
        type: "words, chars",
        wordsClass: "word",
        charsClass: "char",
        aria: false
      });

      gsap.to(split.words, {
        duration: 1,
        stagger: 0.015,
        scrambleText: {
          text: "{original}",
          chars: isAlternative ? "#$!" : "upperCase", // try different sets
          speed: 0.4
        },
        scrollTrigger: {
          trigger: target,
          start: "top bottom",
          once: true
        },
        // Reduce DOM size after animation
        onComplete: () => split.revert()
      });
    });
  }

  // Initialize Scramble
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
    initScrambleOnScroll();
  });
</script>

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollTrigger, SplitText);
  const defaultStagger = 0.04;
  const defaultDelay = 0.7;
  const splitMap = new WeakMap();

  function splitIfNeeded(wrapper) {
    if (splitMap.has(wrapper)) {
      try { splitMap.get(wrapper).revert(); } catch (e) {}
    }
    const split = new SplitText(wrapper, {
      type: "words,chars",
      wordsClass: "single-word",
      charsClass: "single-char"
    });
    // keep the split chars out of the a11y tree; the h1 keeps its aria-label
    split.chars.forEach((c) => c.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true"));
    splitMap.set(wrapper, split);
    return split;
  }

  function playTypewriter(wrapper) {
    const stagger = parseFloat(wrapper.getAttribute("data-tt-stagger")) || defaultStagger;
    splitIfNeeded(wrapper);
    const targets = wrapper.querySelectorAll(".single-char");
    if (!targets.length) return;

    wrapper.classList.add("isReady");
    gsap.set(targets, { autoAlpha: 0 });

    gsap.timeline({
      onComplete() { ScrollTrigger.refresh(); }
    }).to(targets, {
      autoAlpha: 1,
      duration: 0.2,
      stagger,
      ease: "power1.out"
    });
  }

  function initTypewriters() {
    const wrappers = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll("[data-transition-typewriter]"));
    if (!wrappers.length) return;

    const first = wrappers[0];
    if (first) {
      const firstDelay = parseFloat(first.getAttribute("data-tt-delay")) || defaultDelay;
      gsap.delayedCall(Math.max(0, firstDelay), () => playTypewriter(first));
    }

    wrappers.slice(1).forEach((wrapper) => {
      const delay = parseFloat(wrapper.getAttribute("data-tt-delay")) || defaultDelay;
      ScrollTrigger.create({
        trigger: wrapper,
        start: "top 80%",
        once: true,
        onEnter: () => gsap.delayedCall(Math.max(0, delay), () => playTypewriter(wrapper))
      });
    });

    ScrollTrigger.refresh();
  }

  initTypewriters();

  let resizeTO;
  window.addEventListener("resize", () => {
    clearTimeout(resizeTO);
    resizeTO = setTimeout(() => {
      // re-split so char positions match the new wrap; no height juggling needed
      document.querySelectorAll("[data-transition-typewriter]").forEach((w) => {
        if (splitMap.has(w)) { try { splitMap.get(w).revert(); } catch (e) {} splitMap.delete(w); }
      });
      ScrollTrigger.refresh();
    }, 150);
  });
});
</script>

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollTrigger);

  // Config
  const wrapperDur = 0.6;   // seconds for bubble fade/scale
  const lineDur    = 0.5;   // seconds for line grow
  const stagger    = 0.18;  // delay between containers

  // Master timeline (paused, we play on scroll)
  const master = gsap.timeline({ paused: true });

  const scope = document.querySelector(".center_wrapper");
  if (!scope) return;

  // Shuffle containers for random order
  const containers = gsap.utils.shuffle(
    gsap.utils.toArray(".bubble_container", scope)
  );

  // Initial states
  gsap.set(containers.map(c => c.querySelector(".bubble_wrapper")), {
    opacity: 0,
    scale: 0.6
  });
  gsap.set(containers.map(c => c.querySelector(".bubble_line-wrapper")), {
    scale: 0
  });

  // Build per-container timelines
  containers.forEach((container, i) => {
    const bubble = container.querySelector(".bubble_wrapper");
    const line   = container.querySelector(".bubble_line-wrapper");
    if (!bubble || !line) return;

    const tl = gsap.timeline();
    tl.to(bubble, {
        opacity: 1,
        scale: 1,
        duration: wrapperDur,
        ease: "power2.out"
      })
      .to(line, {
        scale: 1,
        duration: lineDur,
        ease: "power2.out"
      });

    master.add(tl, i * stagger);
  });

  // Trigger animation on scroll
  ScrollTrigger.create({
    trigger: scope,
    start: "top 70%",
    once: true,
    onEnter: () => master.play()
  });

  // Respect reduced motion
  if (window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches) {
    master.progress(1).kill();
  }
});
</script>


<script>
(() => {
  function initCardReveal() {
    if (!window.gsap || !window.ScrollTrigger) return;
    gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollTrigger);

    const animated = document.querySelectorAll('[data-anim=card]');
    if (!animated.length) return; // no cards on this page, nothing to animate

    // Set the initial hidden state
    gsap.set(animated, {
      yPercent: 20,
      opacity: 0
    });

    // Reveal on enter, batched with stagger
    ScrollTrigger.batch(animated, {
      onEnter: batch => {
        gsap.to(batch, {
          yPercent: 0,
          opacity: 1,
          duration: 0.6,
          stagger: 0.4,
          ease: 'power2.out',
          overwrite: true
        });
      },
      once: true // play only once
    });

    ScrollTrigger.refresh();
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initCardReveal);
  } else {
    initCardReveal();
  }
})();
</script>
